Wallpaper packs

These are the finished wallpapers: 2560×1440 JPEGs, zipped by gallery. Every one was found and rendered with the search and rendering methods this site describes. They're free to use under CC BY 4.0. If you share them, credit Matt Fisher.

If you want a different size, open any picture in the explorer and download it at the resolution you need, or render it yourself with the code in fractal-wallpapers.

The best of the main gallery

A few friends voted on the main gallery, and these are the pictures they liked most. Each pack contains the one before it.
